chunks: Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a man who missed some of the prayers, then remembered at sunrise or at sunset, he said: “Then let him pray when he remembers.”

key_terms.الصَّلَوَاتِ: the prescribed prayers that had been missed
key_terms.طُلُوعِ: the rising, here referring to sunrise
key_terms.غُرُوبِهَا: its setting, here referring to sunset

ai.seo_question: If someone remembers a missed prayer at sunrise or sunset, should they pray it right away?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about missed salat (prayer). If a person remembers a missed prayer at sunrise or sunset, he should perform it immediately upon remembering.
